propositions: The module-size gate shell step aborts with exit 1 when the allowlist is fully drained (contains only comments/whitespace) because grep returns exit 1 on no match, triggering set -e pipefail termination before the over-cap check runs.
The grep command in the listed= line must be guarded with '|| true' to tolerate empty allowlists while preserving fail-on-over-cap behavior for non-empty allowlists.
Both .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml and .github/workflows/test.yml contain the identical listed= line and require the same one-line fix applied independently.
The allowlist-emptying change (reconcile.py / epic 716f) cannot pass Verified until this fix lands on main, since the gate runs from main's workflow against each change's tree.
The parity test must continue to pass and the gate must still fail when a non-allow-listed file exceeds 800 LOC after the fix.
